input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Beyond Measure"?

documents.text: Beyond Measure (Dynasty album) Beyond Measure is the second studio album from Dynasty. Facedown Records released the album on January 22, 2013. Dynasty worked with Andrew P. Glover in the production of this album. Awarding the album three and a half stars, Tony D. Bryant from "HM Magazine" stated, ""Beyond Measure" is full of adrenaline-pumping lyrics and circle pits... with guitars, drums and vocals all blending to a hard, fast and full-of-emotion album.
